name: c1_01-tape-play
note: U-07: DBSIM argument -ptapes\demo2 (registry game_arguments): plays the installation's TAPES\DEMO2.TAP (1,901 records, joystick-button bits 1-3 and 8-11, R+0Dh, 73 queued keys, no mouse events) until the short read ends playback (0x45a97c); the header overwrites the launch files, which the tape transaction restores. Live Ctrl+B at 200 during playback, Up after the tape end. Bounded window of 2,000 frames.
